main_body: wooden choir stall with an overhanging canopy top, five recessed arched backrest panels, and a bench seat with five red cushions
top_band: rows 8-12 medium-brown canopy top surface with gold finials along row 8 and a distinct pinkish-tan front-edge highlight along row 12 (plus a second horizontal top surface on the bench seat at rows 37-40 with red cushions and a light-brown front edge at row 40)
evidence: Reading down column 24: rows 8-11 form a 4-row medium-brown horizontal top surface on the canopy, row 12 is a 1-row lighter front-edge line, and rows 13-14 form a 2-row dark eave shadow overhanging the vertical backrest (rows 15-35, which has inset arched panels). Below the backrest, the bench seat also shows a 4-row horizontal top surface (rows 37-40, with red cushions on rows 37-38, wood seat on row 39, and a lighter front-edge line on row 40) above a shadowed front apron (rows 41-47).

style.evidence: While the brown palette has 6 value steps and dark-brown material outlines, the interior of each arched backrest panel contains a ~5x13 pixel area of a single flat brown colour with no wood grain or speckle, the red cushions are flat 6x2 two-stripe rectangles without form shading, and the cornice and base mouldings are unbroken ruler-straight horizontal lines across 46 pixels, looking much stiffer and flatter than the textured wood and shaded props in the Beodeul references.
